clips.title: The story
paras: Treacherous Cold is a recovery effort in the treacherous high peaks of Dun Morogh following devastating snow and ice slides. Adventurers are tasked with retrieving the inscribed rifles of fallen Ironforge mountaineers to ensure their identities are confirmed and their families receive closure.

The rugged, snowy crags of Dun Morogh pose a constant danger to travelers and soldiers alike. Even the hardened mountaineers of Ironforge can find themselves overwhelmed by sudden avalanches and sheets of falling ice, with novice recruits paying with their lives when winter strikes without warning.

When mountain slides bury patrols, searching the hazardous terrain becomes a grim race against time. Heightened elemental activity across the region makes thorough rescue expeditions perilous, forcing scouts to enlist brave wanderers to search the drifts for fallen mountaineers and recover their inscribed rifles before the snow conceals them forever.

Every Ironforge mountaineer engraves their name into the stock of their rifle, serving as a lasting mark of identification in the harshest conditions. By securing these firearms from the drifts, searchers ensure the fallen can be identified and their honored service recognized by their families back in Ironforge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.
